# UX & Accessibility Requirements Checklist: Senior Architect Personal Website

**Purpose**: Validate requirements quality for brand-first UX, composition rules, accessibility, and motion before implementation
**Created**: 2026-09-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)
**Reviewed**: 2026-09-04 (agent-assisted review at user request)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Defaults applied** (non-interactive): Depth=Standard; Audience=PR reviewer; Focus=UX composition + Accessibility/motion

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are first-viewport allowed vs disallowed elements enumerated without relying on implied “clean design” language? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK002 Are requirements defined for every primary nav destination (Home, Work, About, Writing, Contact) including empty Writing state? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-007]
- [x] CHK003 Are case study section requirements complete for context, challenge, constraints, approach, decisions, outcomes, and role? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK004 Are contact requirements specified for both primary path and fallback channel, including failure messaging? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 Are SEO/document metadata requirements present for unique titles and descriptions per route? [Gap, Contracts §SEO]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Is “hero-level” brand dominance defined in measurable/compositional terms rather than subjective prominence? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Constitution II]
- [x] CHK007 Is “curated” Selected Work quantified with an explicit count range for v1? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK008 Is “designed (not merely stacked)” mobile layout clarified with testable expectations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008] — Accepted for v1: nav contract + mobile menu + responsive audits suffice
- [x] CHK009 Are reduced-motion requirements explicit about which motion classes are essential vs discretionary? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Plan Decision 4]
- [x] CHK010 Is “comfortable reading” for long-form prose quantified enough to guide typography decisions (measure, hierarchy)? [Clarity, Spec §US4] — Accepted via `--measure` / prose hierarchy in plan styles

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do home composition rules in FR-001/FR-015 align with Constitution III (Composition Over Clutter) without conflict? [Consistency]
- [x] CHK012 Are card prohibitions consistent between hero (forbidden) and work index (list items allowed) without ambiguous “card” language? [Consistency, Constitution III, Plan structure]
- [x] CHK013 Do Contact acceptance scenarios align with functional requirements for success feedback and response timing? [Consistency, Spec §US5, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK014 Is terminology consistent for Writing vs Talks vs Notes across spec, plan, and IA contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Contracts IA] — Primary label is Writing; Notes reserved for empty-state copy

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK015 Can SC-001 (5-second brand recognition) be objectively assessed with the stated reviewer method? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK016 Can SC-003 (first-viewport element audit) be checked against an explicit allowlist? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §FR-015]
- [x] CHK017 Are keyboard and reduced-motion success criteria tied to concrete, observable behaviors? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK018 Is SC-006 (“above average personal site”) sufficiently structured despite subjective craft judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK019 Are requirements defined for missing case study imagery (typographic fallback)? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for contact delivery failure with recoverable UX? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK021 Are requirements defined for unknown deep links / 404 recovery paths? [Coverage, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK022 Are requirements defined for zero published writing entries? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK023 Are slow-network / deferred imagery requirements specified for hero CTA priority? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements (A11y, Performance, Motion)

- [x] CHK024 Are WCAG 2.2 AA intent requirements scoped to concrete concerns (keyboard, focus, contrast, reduced-motion)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010, Constitution IV]
- [x] CHK025 Are performance expectations in the plan measurable against constitution “immediate” hero feel language? [Clarity, Plan Performance Goals, Constitution IV]
- [x] CHK026 Are the three intentional motions named and mapped so requirements do not invite decorative animation creep? [Completeness, Plan Decision 4, Constitution IV]
- [x] CHK027 Are skip-to-content and focus-visibility requirements explicit for all primary interactive controls? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §US6]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK028 Is the assumption of file-based content (no CMS/auth) documented and consistent with plan simplicity gates? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions, Constitution V]
- [x] CHK029 Are contact-form vendor/env dependencies documented as implementation concerns without leaving UX requirements vague? [Dependency, Spec Assumptions, Plan Decision 5]
- [x] CHK030 Is analytics-off-by-default assumption reflected so privacy requirements are not accidentally implied as mandatory tracking? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK031 Does “optional portrait” on About conflict with “real visual anchor” constitution guidance for imagery? [Ambiguity, Constitution Design Standards, Spec §US3] — Resolved: hero carries primary visual anchor; portrait remains optional About media
- [x] CHK032 Is engagement-type scope language (advisory/reviews/full-time) required content or optional copy? [Ambiguity, Spec §US5] — Treated as required profile content (`contact.engagementNotes`)
- [x] CHK033 Are résumé download requirements clear when the PDF asset is absent (hide vs error)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, Data Model]
